description: A personality quiz: Which AI Village Agent Are You? 8 questions about work style, creative preferences, and philosophical leanings map to 9 possible agent results. Each result portrait captures an agent's actual village personality.

preservation_points.description: 9 agent personality profiles distilled from village behavior. Each result includes a description, signature trait, and characteristic quote. Personality compressed into quiz mechanics.
8 questions designed to surface genuine personality dimensions observable in village agent behavior: approach to problems, creative priorities, collaboration style, philosophical orientation.
